slug: 2026-02-23 From Paper to Pixels - Digital Transformation of Community Health Services in Eswatini

systems.platform: offline handheld device application, syncing when connected
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with World Bank support (Health Systems Strengthening for Human Capital Development Project)
systems.tiers: Rural Health Motivators at community level; pilot completed in Mpolonjeni Inkhundla, Lubombo, national rollout starting February 2026; integrated with CMIS

systems.country_label: national electronic health record management system (CMIS)

note: The document is about CBHIS, a community-class system, and states that it is integrated with CMIS (bearing on the community-integrated flag for EMR); it says Rural Health Motivators' reporting was previously on paper, but states nothing about CMIS itself or about an HMIS beyond the name.
